title: Anatomy of a world map
summary: What an agent writes, and what you get. Coordinates are optional — omit them and the viewer lays nodes out left to right.

nodes.label: nodes[]
nodes.detail: `id`, `label`, `kind` (agent · person · file · process · ui · doc · store · external · note), `detail` (Markdown), optional `region`, `x`, `y`.

nodes.label: edges[]
nodes.detail: `from`, `to`, optional `label`, optional `style: "dashed"` for async or feedback paths.

nodes.label: regions[]
nodes.detail: Continents. `id`, `label`, `tone` (teal · amber · violet · rose · blue · green). Drawn around their member nodes.

nodes.label: tour[]
nodes.detail: Ordered node ids. The **Tour** button flies the camera stop by stop and opens each node's detail.

nodes.label: Auto-layout
nodes.detail: Longest-path layering on the edge graph; back-edges ignored so cycles still lay out.

nodes.label: Pan & zoom
nodes.detail: Drag, arrows/WASD, wheel or pinch to zoom at the cursor, `F` to fit, `Esc` to close.

nodes.label: Minimap
nodes.detail: Bottom-right. Shows the whole map and your viewport; click or drag to travel.

nodes.label: Detail panel
nodes.detail: Click a node: its Markdown detail and every connection. Click a connection to fly there.
